newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian crude palm oil stable after tender.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian crude palm oil stable after tender.

text.p: Indonesian crude palm oil (CPO) and olein prices were stable in a quiet local market on Wednesday despite a weakening in Malaysian prices, traders said.
They said a CPO tender sold in Medan for 1,205 rupiah/kg, the same as on Tuesday. Traders said if tax and transport charges were excluded, the price was about 1,075 rupiah/kg.
"Buyers are staying out of the market as they see prices coming down. They have heard about a lot of imports soon coming into the local market from Malaysia," one trader said.
Ready olein was quoted stable at around 1,400 rupiah/kg in Medan and at 1,455-70 rupiah/kg in Jakarta and Surabaya.
October delivery for olein was quoted at 1,430 rupiah/kg.
